description: This file defines types and functions related to handling and processing stack frames, including fetching original stack frame data and formatting frame source information, within a React development overlay context.

methods.name: getOriginalStackFrames
methods.description: Fetches original stack frames for an array of frames, considering server-side context.

methods.name: getOriginalStackFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the original stack frame data for a given source frame, handling external and internal frames, with error handling.

methods.name: getFrameSource
methods.description: Generates a string representation of a stack frame's source location, including URL, line, and column information.
